rules: A first test failure fails the job.
One diagnostic re-run is allowed; a re-run success never converts the result to success.
A test that fails then passes unchanged is classified FLAKY_CONFIRMED.
A FLAKY_CONFIRMED test that a task requires for proof blocks that task's closure.
Every quarantine has an owner and an expiry date; expiry without a fix becomes EXPIRED_QUARANTINE and blocks closure.
Retry is never used to hide failure.
Deleting a test or weakening an assertion requires an independent task contract.
Flaky evidence counts as zero evidence: required proofs with flaky results resolve to NEEDS_EVIDENCE.
